item.title: The percentage of Show HN posts is increasing, but their scores are decreasing
item.description:
📝 Percentage For about ten years (2012~2022), the percentage of Show HN stories was around 2-3%. Scores Show HN stories used to receive similar scores (around 15-18) to those of all stories until 2023~2024. I would like to analyze the percentage of Show HN stories generated with LLMs but I couldn’t find the way to do this, because many Show HN stories don’t mention that they’ve used LLMs in their text.
🔗 Read more: https://snubi.net/posts/Show-HN/
